text:
marcos: Quick heads-up — I'm going to sweep small style/format nits in PR #1720 today. Mostly naming + formatting (no logic changes). Plan is to land Fri 10:00am PT unless there are objections. Please approve if you have cycles.

priya: Is CI green? any flaky tests we should watch for?

marcos: CI is green on my branch right now. saw one flaky in integ/test_cache earlier but it was unrelated to this PR. full run: ```ok  all tests passed (unit+lint)```

jon: Quick nit: in `handler.go` you use `reqID` in a few places. Could we switch to `request_id` for consistency with tracing tags? small rename + update comment should be fine.

sara: I can take the rename + add a tiny test for header propagation. After that I'll rebase and push. :+1:

priya: Also can you run `gofmt -w .` and `golangci-lint run --fix`? That should knock out the formatting nits automatically.

marcos: Yep. pushing a tiny patch now — diff: ```diff
--- a/handler.go
+++ b/handler.go
@@ -45,7 +45,7 @@ func handle(req Request) {
-    reqID := req.Headers.Get("x-req-id")
-    ctx = trace.WithID(ctx, reqID)
+    request_id := req.Headers.Get("x-req-id")
+    ctx = trace.WithID(ctx, request_id)
 }
```

deploy-bot: CI/Build #1720 passed — all checks green :white_check_mark:

jon: Approved after rename + CI green. :thumbsup:

sara: LGTM, will rebase + push, then mark approved

marcos: Thanks all — will hold the merge slot for Fri 10:00am PT. If anyone needs earlier, ping me.
